shots.line: Two hundred feet above the trees, a train climbs the lift hill.
shots.scene: park: crane move beside the climbing train, time block + height card

shots.line: Nine cars. Thirty six riders. One bar across every lap.
shots.scene: park: low wide looking up at the crest, tags on the train

shots.line: That night, twelve coasters were shut across the country.
shots.scene: usmap: dark map, glowing park dots, Georgia highlighted

shots.line: One witness said the bar looked loose when the car came back.
You always expect to get back, one rider said.
In the left seat, the captain. Two control columns, linked together.
shots.scene: cockpit: clay cockpit, captain at the yoke, lower third + tags

shots.line: Behind the door, one hundred and seventy four passengers.
shots.scene: cabin: clay cabin rows, stat plate

shots.line: Twenty one minutes past eight. The aircraft is level at thirty four thousand feet.
shots.scene: sky: clay airliner exterior, time chip

shots.line: Then the line on the tracking screen turns west, toward the border.
shots.scene: mapME: extruded map, route draws, chips

shots.line: In under a minute, it falls more than fourteen thousand feet.
shots.scene: 2d chart: altitude line draws, annotation pill

shots.line: The transponder changes. Seven seven zero zero. General emergency.
Investigators are looking at three possibilities.
Inside the lock, a ratchet on a toothed wheel.
Photos taken afterwards show the train back in the station.
Each is a possibility, not a finding.
